kebab_example: aliyun sysom invoke-diagnosis --service-name memgraph --channel ecs --params instance_:_i-wz9gdv7qmdhusamc4dl01_,_uid_:_xxxxxxxxxxxxxx_,_region_:_cn-shenzhen --region cn-hangzhou
name: InvokeDiagnosis

parameters.help_en: The diagnosis channel (currently fixed to the ECS channel)
parameters.help_zh: 诊断通道（目前固定为ecs通道）
parameters.name: channel

parameters.help_en:
The diagnosis parameters. Different diagnosis types require different parameters. Refer to the supplementary request parameter descriptions below for the parameters required by each diagnosis type.

<notice>Pass a JSON-formatted string.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
诊断参数，不同类型的诊断要求传递不同的诊断参数，每种诊断所需的参数参见下面的请求参数补充说明。

<notice>请传递 json 格式的字符串></notice>
parameters.name: params

parameters.help_en: The diagnosis type. This parameter distinguishes between different types of diagnostics
parameters.help_zh: 诊断类型，用于区分不同类型的诊断
parameters.name: service_name

code.description_en:
The status code.
`code == Success` indicates that the authorization is successful.
Other status codes indicate the authorization is failed. Check the `message` field for the detailed fault information
code.description_zh:
状态码
`code == Success` 则代表授权成功；
其它状态码代表授权失败，授权失败时查看 `message` 字段获取详细的错误信息；

task_id.description_en: The diagnostic task ID. You can use this ID to call the `GetDiagnosisResult` operation to query the diagnosis result
task_id.description_zh: 诊断任务ID，可以凭借该ID调用 `GetDiagnosisResult` 接口查询诊断结果

message.description_en:
The error message.
If `code == Success`, this field is empty.
Otherwise, this field contains the request error information
message.description_zh:
错误信息
如果 `code == Success`，则本字段为空；
否则本字段包含请求错误信息
message.example: SysomOpenAPIAssumeRoleException: EntityNotExist.Role The role not exists: acs:ram::xxxxx:role/aliyunserviceroleforsysom
